faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Silchar Project Associate – I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send the application via email for the Project Associate – I post at NIT Silchar is 25 August 2026. Candidates should ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate – I at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate – I post in the National Institute of Technology Silchar recruitment drive. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Silchar Project Associate – I posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Associate – I recruitment at NIT Silchar is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Associate – I position at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate – I position ranges from Rs. 30000 to Rs. 37000 per month. This also includes HRA as per the details mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Associate – I post must possess an MSc. in Chemistry or BS-MS in Chemistry from a recognized university or institution. Specific details are in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Silchar Project Associate – I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Silchar Project Associate – I Recruitment 2026. All candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate – I position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per Government of India rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Associate – I at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate – I post at NIT Silchar primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Project Associate – I post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate – I post is Silchar, Assam. National Institute of Technology Silchar is located in this city, where the selected candidate will be working.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the email application?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs along with their bio-data. Refer to the official notification for a complete list.
